'''Agent Protarius''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] who served the [[Republic Strategic Information Service]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Stationed on [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]], he tasked a Republic [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] to track down and eliminate the merciless [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Dakron]] who had recently landed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]].
